title: Accu-Chek Combo Unable to pair
body:
Hello, my mobile phone is Android15，Currently using AAPS 3.3.0DEV.After I change this phone, I can't connect with it.Accu-Chek Combo Unable to pair，I have tried to disable the full-screen notification display myself，Still no effect.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f705d95e-3547-45b0-a834-8582b1ff012a

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1751988502378.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21124976/AndroidAPS_LOG_1751988502378.log.zip)

comments.body: The AAPS version is 3.3.3.0DEV, and I have tried 3.3.2.0 is still the same problem.
Do you use the "my BMW" app? we've seen strange interference with other pumps (medtrum and dash) from that app..

> 您是否使用“my BMW”应用程序？我们已经从那个应用程序看到其他泵（Medtrum 和 DASH）受到奇怪的干扰..

I'm sorry, I don't have this software. It should be that the window was full-screen when the scan was visible in advance, which led to AAPS misunderstanding and quit.
This is the prompt selection window, which is displayed in full screen and cannot be paired
